Quiz: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace Story Quiz
Question: What did the three men say even if God did not deliver them?
OptionA: We will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image
Explanation: They said, 'But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image.'
